title: ResearchPaperDeepDive
description: A structured schema for generating a comprehensive understanding and critical analysis of a research paper.

tl_dr.description: A one-sentence hook summarizing the paper's main contribution.

problem_statement.description: The specific problem or pain point the authors are trying to solve.

current_gap.description: Why existing solutions fail or are insufficient (The 'Gap').

hypothesis_or_claim.description: The central thesis or proposed solution.

approach_name.description: Name of the model, algorithm, or framework proposed.

key_mechanisms.description: List of core technical steps (e.g., 'Attention Mechanism', 'Double-Blind Study', 'PCR Analysis').

dataset_or_materials.description: Data sources, sample sizes, or materials used.

unexpected_results.description: Any anomalies or surprising outcomes noted by authors.

critical_analysis.description: Subjective and objective critique of the work.

novelty_assessment.description: Is this incremental or a breakthrough? Why?

limitations_and_weaknesses.description: Flaws admitted by authors or spotted in review.

validity_rating.description: 1-10 scale of how robust the evidence is.

definitions_and_concepts.description: Key jargon or concepts required to understand the paper.
